name: paper-project
description: Research-paper workflows plus evidence-aware persona deliberation.

interface.shortDescription: Research-paper workflows for reading, writing, and figures.
interface.longDescription: Paper Project provides research-paper and dissertation planning, evidence-aware writing, citation validation, scientific figure creation, Zotero reading of all literature attachments, user-authorized library management, and separate project note-generation workflows, and presentations. It also provides moderated, Nuwa-derived persona roundtables for comparing reasoning frameworks.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me choose and use the right Paper Project skill for this research task.
